definitions.explanation: A traditional Japanese martial art of archery, emphasizing form, breathing, and spiritual discipline over accuracy.

examples.japanese: {高校|こうこう}で{弓道|きゅうどう}を{始|はじ}めた。
examples.english: I started kyudo in high school.

examples.japanese: {弓道|きゅうどう}は{精神|せいしん}{統一|とういつ}が{大切|たいせつ}だ。
examples.english: Mental focus is important in kyudo.

examples.japanese: {弓道|きゅうどう}{場|じょう}で{練習|れんしゅう}する。
examples.english: I practice at the archery hall.

notes:
COMPOUND: {弓|きゅう} (bow) + {道|どう} (way, path)

EQUIPMENT:
・{弓|ゆみ} (bow) - Japanese bows are asymmetric
・{矢|や} (arrow)
・{的|まと} (target)
・{弓道着|きゅうどうぎ} (kyudo uniform)
・{袴|はかま} (traditional pants)
・ゆがけ (glove)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・{弓道|きゅうどう}をする (to do kyudo)
・{弓道|きゅうどう}{部|ぶ} (archery club)
・{弓道|きゅうどう}{場|じょう} (archery hall)
・{的|まと}に{当|あ}たる (to hit the target)
・{射法|しゃほう}{八節|はっせつ} (eight stages of shooting)

CULTURAL NOTE:
Kyudo emphasizes the beauty of form and spiritual discipline (射即人生 "shooting is life"). Unlike Western archery, the goal is perfection of character through practice.
